registration_sequence.parallelization: Circles 1-5 can run in parallel per connector; Circle 6 runs continuously
registration_sequence.coordination: Mapa orchestrates; each producer repo retains authority over its implementation

operational_contracts.contract_1: No connector advances past Circle 1 without authority boundary validation
operational_contracts.contract_2: Zero TOKEN_VAZIO erased; all gaps documented with closure paths
operational_contracts.contract_3: All receipts immutable; ledger is append-only
operational_contracts.contract_4: Autonomous processes (Circle 6) run continuously; escalate anomalies
operational_contracts.contract_5: Cross-repo dependencies validated; cyclic dependencies cause FAIL_CLOSED
operational_contracts.contract_6: Evidence scope (local/federated/third-party) declared for every claim

escalation_protocol.authority_conflict: Escalate to RafGitTools (versioning authority); Mapa mediates
escalation_protocol.circular_dependency: Detected by AT-02; fail registration; document in audit trail
escalation_protocol.stale_evidence: AE-02 flags; suggest re-validation; do not auto-promote stale receipts
escalation_protocol.device_failure: TermuxApp connector fails; revert to local-only scope; flag TOKEN_VAZIO_RUNNER
escalation_protocol.producer_divergence: PC-03 cross-repo audit detects divergence; notify producer authority
